meta.name: budget-optimizer
meta.description: Reallocate marketing spend across channels using performance data and diminishing-returns modeling — produces a current-vs-optimized allocation table, projected ROI ranges with confidence intervals, a phased 4-8 week reallocation timeline, and a 10-15% testing reserve. Recommends shifts only; it never changes spend on any platform. Triggers on "/digital-marketing-pro:budget-optimizer", "optimize my marketing budget", "which channels should get more spend", "reallocate budget based on ROAS", "is our channel split right". Reads the brand profile and guidelines, runs scripts/budget-optimizer.py, and pairs with /digital-marketing-pro:budget-tracker for in-flight pacing.
